tenant_lane.source: Registered source writes typed audit.intent.recorded into P04 transactional outbox with local mutation
tenant_lane.provenance: Validate envelope scope/source/type/version/payload and committed outbox content before accepting even completed generic receipt
tenant_lane.atomic_effect: Ledger record/head and durable receipt commit before ACK
tenant_lane.failure: Bounded P04 retry and terminal dead-letter behavior remain transport authority; no DB outage becomes successful ACK

platform_lane.source: nexus_sentinel inserts typed immutable platform_audit_intents inside same local transaction as supported Sentinel mutation
platform_lane.worker: PlatformAuditWorker reads only committed journal rows
platform_lane.atomic_effect: Record, independent head and successful receipt commit together
platform_lane.replay: Reparse committed intent and compare semantic digest before returning existing record/receipt
platform_lane.terminal_poison: Invalid typed intent receives immutable INVALID_INTENT receipt, null record reference and no success fact; later sources proceed
platform_lane.unexpected_failure: Database or integrity errors stop processing without false success; journal remains durable for restart
platform_lane.run_once_result: Count of inspected sources, including terminal invalid sources; not count of successful facts

operational_entrypoint.shutdown: SIGINT/SIGTERM cancels in-flight work and bounds transaction drain/connection close
operational_entrypoint.startup_failure_logging: Fixed sanitized failure message without exception or payload

atomicity_limits: Local source mutation plus source intent is atomic; subsequent ledger processing is durable eventual ingestion
P04 publish_global remains direct confirmed publication and is not represented as transactional durable outbox
Remote provider effects cannot be made atomic with PostgreSQL; local dispatch authorization and observed/ambiguous outcomes remain separate facts
No arbitrary log ingestion or replacement generic broker
